result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and continuous sidewalks. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic signals are present, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and has sightline obstructions from parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the left side of the image block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection along the curb

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks dedicated walk/don't-walk signals for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signal pole on the corner

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalks to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: This is a signalized residential intersection featuring marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. While basic infrastructure is present, the environment lacks advanced safety features like curb extensions or daylighting to improve visibility and reduce crossing distances.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the side street may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb of the intersecting street.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt within the intersection and crosswalk area could present minor trip hazards or affect vehicle traction.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection roadway.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks. However, the environment is compromised by poor pavement quality within the crossing and potential sightline obstructions from corner vegetation.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement in Crosswalk
hazards.description: A large, uneven asphalt patch or pothole repair is located directly in the path of the crosswalk, creating a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, within the marked crosswalk area.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Tall hedges on the corner property may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and drivers approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the corner of the residential property.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to ensure a smooth, level walking surface within the crosswalk markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and curb ramps with tactile warnings, controlled by traffic signals. However, dedicated pedestrian signal heads are not visible, and large corner vegetation creates a significant visual obstruction for road users.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large bushes at the corner of the intersection may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left corner near the street sign

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The lane markings and crosswalk paint are significantly worn, reducing visibility and clarity of the intended path.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove the large bushes at the corner to improve sightlines for all road users according to daylighting principles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and improve safety.

interventions.title: Pavement Marking Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk and lane markings with high-visibility materials to improve compliance and driver awareness.
